rows.label: Mastery Rank 5
rows.note: to craft the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment

conditions: The 10 codes used by the Upgrade Segment are consumed; they do not count toward the 10 needed to incubate a kavat.
The first Incubator Power Core comes from the Venus-to-Mercury Junction. Later attempts consume another crafted core.

rows.label: Cross-Matrix Widget
rows.note: 45% chance for each scan to count twice

conditions: Codes only come from scans that land while the Feral Kavat is alive; a corpse scan gives Simaris standing, never a code.
Sands of Inaros, if unfinished, spawns up to ~50 Feral Kavats on its second tomb trip. Stack drop boosters first: the quest can't be replayed.
Stack Steel Path (+100% drop chance) with a Resource Drop Chance Booster before farming; without any stack the grind is much worse.
Pack size is squad size plus one, but codes are personal: in a squad every player must scan every cat themselves.
Avoid ragdoll effects (Bastille, Strangledome, Spellbind) and wide-area kills. Sleep, slow, invisibility or Limbo Stasis preserves cats for scanning.
bonuses: Dante's Noctua scans on a killing blow even after the Codex entry is complete, though it ignores Simaris widgets and needs the killing hit itself.
A full squad raises each pack to five cats.

disclosures.title: Synoid Heliocor is unreliable here
disclosures.body: Several players report the hammer stops giving codes once the Feral Kavat Codex entry is complete, likely because a one-hit kill doesn't register the scan. Don't build the farm around it; a sleep or stealth frame with a Synthesis Scanner is the safer pick.

conditions: The blueprint comes from Tenno Lab research; Hyekka Masters, including Spear on Mars, can also drop it.
Argon Crystal decays at daily reset, so pick it up last and build the segment right away.
bonuses: A built segment is also sold in the Market for 175 platinum.

conditions: The reusable blueprint costs 50,000 credits in the Market. Do not spend resources building a core if the Junction freebie is still available.
A wrong Random Incubation result consumes another core as well as another 10 codes.

rows.label: Adarza Kavat
rows.note: roughly a coin flip against Smeeta, unconfirmed odds
rows.alt: use two Adarza Genetic Code Templates

conditions: Random Incubation cannot be directed to Adarza. A Smeeta result has no pity protection and starts another 10-code attempt.
Two matching Adarza imprints replace the breed roulette but do not replace the 10 codes or Power Core.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 hours with the separate Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment; rushing costs 15 platinum.
bonuses: Adarza imprints are tradeable. A mature kavat can make three, and each template has a reusable 50,000-credit blueprint with a 6-hour build time.

disclosures.title: the coin flip favors you here
disclosures.body: Adarza is the breed most people are trying to avoid when they're farming for Smeeta, so the frustration threads ("19 Adarzas before a Smeeta") run the other direction. A random incubation is a reasonable gamble for this goal. Two matching imprints from a friend remove the gamble entirely and still only cost the standard 10 codes and one Power Core.
